The 'texture_anomaly' (Router: 1.5) is also notable; the perfect bilateral symmetry of the banding is highly suspicious for AI generation. The expert testimonies support this: the fine_grained_classifier confirms the class, but the topology_boundary_auditor's mask confidence (0.85) is borderline, hinting at boundary ambiguity. The geometric_depth_auditor found no major grounding failures, but the visual 'softness' remains a defect.
